source_text: {The Hodge heat equation is discussed in the FEEC setting in [\BookNumber{10}, Theorem 4.4]. There we show how the results we have obtained for the Hodge Laplacian can be used together with the Hille–Yosida–Phillips theory to establish well-posedness of the parabolic problem. The paper goes on to analyze the Galerkin method, both semidiscrete and, using a simple time-stepping scheme, fully discrete. Optimal order error estimates are obtained based on an appropriate elliptic projection, whose properties again follow from the elliptic case.}
